facades.name: Stadhouderskade slab front (tile-clad, punched windows)
facades.note: Commons Milliped 2013 (CC BY-SA 4.0). Above the gold-edged gallery roof: six storeys of four wide window pairs alternating with four small square windows (8 openings per band, rows staggered), then the set-back top storey with five wide windows. The ground band is the gallery shopfront under the canopy and is not counted. The fifth set-back window stands over the two-bay tower link, outside the crop (alongM starts at the gallery canopy's park-end edge, the slab ends at ~33.3 m). Top band: four set-back windows plus the drum penthouse's glazed storey (one ribbon: its panes are divided by thin gold mullions) = 5.

facades.name: tower north-west flank on the Tesselschadestraat
facades.note: Panorama 2021 at 13 m. Four bays between dark piers 0.5 m wide (wider than the ribbon gap, so four openings per band): the glazed shop plinth, then twelve office storeys. Cropped to the tower; the rooftop plant box is not visible from the street and is cut by heightM.
